source.exact_quote:
画像、Markdown、tool node ID、file pathだけをtemplate identityや設計意味の主キーにしない。

## §2 component境界

| component | 入力 | 出力 | 責務 | failure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DesignTemplateRegistry` | versioned template JSON | exact template set、registry digest | ID/version/supersessionとschema束縛 | duplicate、unknown version、digest drift |
| `ApplicabilityEvaluator` | requirement atom、obligation、risk、style/layer、typed predicate | applicable/non-applicable＋理由 | `all`/`any`/`not`のfail-close評価 | unknown operator/field/enum、自由文条件 |
| `TemplateShadowCompiler` | 既存template/canonical design inventory | shadow template候補、parity finding | 既存意味を新正本候補へ一方向変換 | 未分類、意味欠落、二重authority |
| `GeneratedViewProjector` | validated template/instance/graph JSON | Markdown/HTML/Mermaid＋source digest | 決定論表示 | source digest不一致、直接編集 |
| `DesignPortfolioPlanner` | Requirement JSON、Design Obligation Graph、registry | reuse/delta/new/N/A proposal | 最小portfolio提案 | uncovered、duplicate、fabricated ID |
| `PairGraphBinder` | selected template/instance、V-pair oracle | L4↔L9、L5↔L8 graph | pair exact setとcompletionを束縛 | missing pair、別revision、stale oracle |

本sliceはcomponent契約だけを定義する。schema/runtime、planner algorithm、instance生成、pair graph
freezeは後続L5/L6 episodeで実装する。

## §3 主要data flow

```text
Requirement JSON
  -> Design Obligation Graph
  -> DesignPortfolioPlanner
  -> selected Design Template JSON exact set
  -> Design Instance JSON
  -> pair graph / Test Design JSON
  -> generated Markdown / HTML / Mermaid
```

back-propagationはfindingまたはproposal eventとしてRequirement Engine／template revisionへ戻す。
generated viewや既存Markdownを読んでJSONを無断更新するreverse flowは禁止する。

consumer_basis.meaning: source/案件適用/保存/運転を分離し、対象revisionの候補を設計・検証pairとowner consumerへtraceする。監査snapshot、file path、名前、hashのみからsource資格/実適用/完了を生成しない。

historical_scope: SEC004の固定L9 caseを純粋な論理関数chainへ結び、実行状態は全件not_executedとして保つ。

pair_cases.meaning: 全366原caseを保持し、そのうち10種ごとの正常tupleをpositiveとしてraw/expected/current axes/final proposalへ結線。negative refsは欠落/相反/未登録/未知source/予期しないrole等の原case。
全366原caseを保持。prior same且つeligibleは10 kind、plus既存FRESH unknown/changed prior caseでoptional priorが新規比較を妨げないことをpositiveとして実rawへ結線。reuse要求/changed/missing/unknownでの拒否・未解決はnegative refs。

oracle_basis.method: 承認済み0f9b L10 whole objectの意味に結び、L9固定caseのexpected_proposal値をFN-01部分出力/FN-02全出力へ明示投影する。expected値をraw inputへ混ぜない。

expectation_freeze.source: original L9 fixed `expected_proposal` values and approved L10 objects

completion.evidence: 366 fixed case mappings only; no runtime execution
completion.coverage: all original L9 cases preserved and linked

raw_fixture_contract.shape: each raw_input_projection.source_json_pointer points to the complete L9 case given.input; no field is inferred from case ID or expected output.
raw_fixture_contract.null_and_absence: fixed L9 shape uses present keys with null as missing-datum value. Entire prior=null denotes not supplied. Omitted key and supplied null are distinct; omitted-key codec behavior remains unclosed.
raw_fixture_contract.synthetic: source cases state synthetic fixed independent owner snapshots. raw config-like material is synthetic hex only, with no actual settings/secrets/credentials/PII.
raw_fixture_contract.case_binding: both function argument sets and output projections carry explicit source pointers; every function_invocations[1].expected_return (expected_return_source_map.case_oracle) is exact original L9 expected_proposal.
raw_fixture_contract.expected_source: positive/negative expected values are not returned from a runtime evaluator; all remain not_executed.

source_authority_binding.authority_note: 0f9b approved_content_head exact L3/L10 objects; PR2954 merge e9a9... admitted decision record on main. L5/L8 own pair relation is paired_document IDs, not a fabricated working-tree revision/hash source pin.

remaining: formal wire/schema/codecと固定fixture外のinvalid shape/digest文法。
実owner/source qualification、root/HEAD実観測、実authority/構成採用/Hook起動/rollback未成立。
L7関数検証、実装前Red/Green/Refactor、runtime/CI、実L9/L10、PO L11受入未実施。
